metadata.title: OpenCouncil AI — Ask your AI assistant about your municipality
metadata.description: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or any AI assistant you use to OpenCouncil and ask what is being discussed and decided in municipal councils.

hero.title: Ask your AI assistant about your municipality
hero.lead: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or any AI assistant you use to OpenCouncil. Your assistant gains access to search, municipalities, people and the full transcribed records of council meetings — and answers with references to the source.
hero.standard: Works over MCP (Model Context Protocol), the open standard AI assistants use to connect to external sources.
hero.example1: What were the most important topics in Attica's municipalities last week?
hero.example2: What has the municipal administration said about childcare centres? Show me exactly what was said.
hero.example3: Draft a social media post with the key positions from the latest council meeting.
hero.example4: What has the council discussed about my neighbourhood?

url.title: Connect
url.intro: The MCP server address is public — no account needed for reading:

claude.title: Claude
claude.step3: Name it OpenCouncil and paste the address.

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT
chatgpt.step1: In ChatGPT, open Settings → Apps & Connectors and enable Developer mode (under Advanced).
chatgpt.step3: Name it OpenCouncil, paste the address, and choose "No authentication".

tokens.title: Personal access
tokens.description: With an OpenCouncil account, your assistant can additionally save highlights in your name: selected excerpts from a meeting's records. Create a personal MCP address and use it instead of the public one.
tokens.signInPrompt: Sign in to create your personal address.
tokens.createdNote: Copy it now — it is shown only once. Treat it like a password: anyone who has it acts as you on OpenCouncil. You can revoke it at any time.
tokens.empty: You have not created a personal address yet.
